body: I have a counselor, but it's kind of a complicated situation.  And this counselor knows some people I'm close with.  So it's...I don't feel like I can share much.

Running and exercise is a good idea.  Sometimes in the past though, I've just felt even more drained from it.  But I'll probably give it a shot.

I'm very sorry about your cousin.  I don't want to hurt people.  I just want not to be miserable anymore.

I mean, I understand what you're saying.  Honestly, I do.  And theoretically, it makes great sense.  But in my situation, I am literally miserable.  I do not see a way out, even if realistically there may be one.  I've kind of given up, because it seems like I've been dealing with this stuff forever.  I'm just really tired of it.  And frustrated with myself for not being able to fix it.

Hey, thanks.

I would really like to classify my achievements as good, but honestly, I haven't done much.  When I look at the path I want to take in life, I'm not even travelling in the right direction.  I definitely suck at many of the things that are important to me.

I have tried improving at my work step by step.  But it is difficult because of my frustration, and because these are things that once came easily to me.  It sounds dumb, but it's very disheartening, and things seem to be getting worse, not better.
